Change service visa to partner B1 visa
Posted from a friend 

I would love your advice, 

I have been in a relationship with my Israeli boyfriend for 8 years and we want to change my typer of visa for partner visa B, does it takes time to receive the first interview in Netanya? 

My visa it's until June.

Should we go directly to the office to request an appointment or should I request my appointment online?

Can I request the process during my time in Israel or they might request to leave the country?

Does any one has experience with Ministry of Interior in Netanya?

Highly appreciated your recommendation 

I hope you can help me 

Thank you
